methodology: Reconciles existing paired physical measurements at each run global peak. Process increments plus total adjustment equal the reported physical increment. CDP heap fields overlap native memory and each other; do not sum them or substitute them for physical acceptance. afterForcedGC can still have active tasks: it is not a settled or unmounted leak check. Only afterTwentyUnmountCycles is an unmounted observation, and only when activeTasks is zero. No new measurement or budget claim.
